releases.notes:
This is a relatively small update to bring this mod up-to-date with Minecraft 1.21.11, the latest version supported on Vulengate.

Normal users should notice no differences from the previous version - no new features have been added, and no existing features have changed.

For developers, though, this is a pretty massive update. Specifically, the codebase has now been migrated from using Yarn mappings to the new official Mojang mappings. This means that many of the types used in method signatures and fields will have changed from previous versions. However, beyond this, no changes have been made to any logic.

## What's Changed
* Updated to Official Mojang Mappings and Added 1.21.11 Support by @Ueva in https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/pull/29

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/compare/2.2.1...3.0.0

releases.notes:
This is a small update to bring this mod up-to-date with Minecraft 1.21.8, the latest version supported on Vulengate.

Normal users should notice no differences from the previous version - no new features have been added, and no existing features have changed.

For developers, this mod now has updated dependencies, uses the new Fabric HUD rendering API (`HudLayerRegistrationCallback` -> `HudElementRegistry`, `IdentifiedLayer` -> `VanillaHudElements`), and uses the updated `DrawingContext` and `MatrixStack` (now `Matrix3x2fStack`) APIs.

## What's Changed
* Update 2.2.1: Update from 1.21.4 to 1.21.8 by @Ueva in https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/pull/28

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/compare/2.2.0...2.2.1

mods.name: vg ClueScrollHUD
mods.description: A lightweight HUD mod for the Vulengate Minecraft server that displays clue scroll objectives and progress.

releases.notes:
For players, this release fixes a bug where extended clue scrolls were always shown as expired. This was caused by extended scroll items not having their expiry date set correctly by the server - instead, their expiry date was announced on Discord. To address this, these pieces of data are now hosted on a public API, for the mod to fetch as needed. At the moment, the API only has one endpoint (https://ueva.dev/api/vgcluescroll/extended/expiry/), but this can easily be extended in the future.

The `/givedebugcluescroll` command (for testing the mod's functionality in singleplayer) was also updated to take an optional argument, allowing you to specify how many tasks to generate for the debug clue scroll.



For developers, `RemoteDataFetcher` was added to support fetching data from the API, and a minor backwards-compatible change was made to `ClueScrollManager` to allow scrolls' expiry dates to be updated.

## What's Changed
* Feature: Fetch Extended Scroll Expiry Time from API by @Ueva in https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/pull/22
* Update Fabric Version:     0.119.2+1.21.4  ->  0.119.3+1.21.4 by @Ueva in https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/pull/24


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/compare/2.1.0...2.2.0

mods.name: vg ClueScrollHUD
mods.description: A lightweight HUD mod for the Vulengate Minecraft server that displays clue scroll objectives and progress.

releases.notes:
For players, this release contains new configuration options that let you change the order (1) in which clue scrolls are navigated between and (2) in which each clue scroll's tasks are displayed on the HUD. Support has also been added for Vulengate's new "weekly2" (i.e., fortnightly) scrolls.

For developers, this release contains minor changes to
- the `ClueScroll` class and other classes that interact with it (based largely around the fact that each clue scroll's inventory position is now stored), and
- new ways to access sorted lists of scrolls and scroll tasks.

This mod now targets Fabric loader version 0.16.14.

## What's Changed
* Feature add sorting options for clue scroll tasks by @Ueva in https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/pull/17
* 15 feature add additional clue scrolls indexing options by @Ueva in https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/pull/18
* Add support for new "weekly2" (i.e., fortnightly) scrolls on VG by @Ueva in ee3cab5.
* Update to Fabric loader version 0.16.14 by @Ueva in 5e02a6a.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ueva/vg-ClueScrollHUD/compare/2.0.0...2.1.0
